Collaborating globally with responsible parties in the regions and local operation units to support our customers around the world. 
Delivering according to customer expectations within budget and expected quality.

Are you passionate about test automation, cutting-edge technology, and building reliable solutions? Take on a key role in developing and improving quality assurance for advanced financial crime prevention platforms at one of the Nordic region’s largest banks. Join a collaborative team where your expertise in automation, data testing, and AI-driven testing approaches will make a real impact!
About the position
Perido are looking for an experienced Senior Test Automation Engineer for our client, one of the largest banks in the Nordic region. The position is based at the bank’s office just north of Stockholm.
Your daily tasks
In this role, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of the platforms and detection capabilities used to prevent financial crime. The environment includes cloud-native data pipelines, rule-based detection, APIs, integrations, and real-time data flows on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong test automation and data-testing expertise with modern AI-assisted and agentic testing approaches. You will work closely with developers, Business Analysts, Requirement Engineers, and architects to build quality into the development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a separate final step.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and maintain automated tests using Python and/or Java and appropriate test automation frameworks
Apply AI-assisted and agentic testing approaches to improve test design, generation, execution, analysis, and maintenance
Test data pipelines, ETL processes, data quality, and data transformations across GCP
Validate rule-based detection engines and complex business logic used in Financial Crime Prevention
Test APIs, integrations, and real-time data flows across distributed systems
Define and continuously improve test strategy, regression coverage, integration testing, and end-to-end testing
Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows
Ensure AI-generated test assets and results are appropriately reviewed, validated, traceable, and reproducible
Identify quality risks early and work closely with the team to resolve them
Promote good testing practices and support the wider team in continuously improving quality engineering

Your characteristics
We are looking for someone who is analytical, proactive and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and a genuine interest in quality and continuous improvement. You are comfortable taking initiative, solving complex problems and working independently, while also enjoying close collaboration with others. You have a structured approach to your work and the ability to communicate technical matters clearly to different stakeholders.
Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? We look forward to reading your application!
Please submit your application for this role in English.
Qualifications:
8–10+ years of relevant experience in test automation, technical testing, quality engineering, or testing of complex software systems
Strong hands-on experience designing and implementing test automation solutions and frameworks
Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java, together with good SQL knowledge
Practical experience with AI-assisted or agentic testing, including the use of AI or agents within the software testing lifecycle
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, preferably including technologies such as BigQuery, Bigtable, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, and Composer
Strong experience in data, ETL, and data quality testing
Experience testing rule-based systems, decision engines, or complex business logic
Good understanding of APIs, system integrations, CI/CD, and end-to-end testing
Strong analytical and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to understand relationships between data, technology, business requirements, and controls
A proactive, delivery-focused mindset, with the ability to take ownership and work effectively in a cross-functional agile team
Strong communication and documentation skills
A B.Sc., M.Sc., Ph.D., or equivalent relevant education and professional experience

 
Advantageous:
Experience within banking, Financial Crime Prevention, transaction monitoring, compliance, or another regulated environment
Experience applying AI-enabled development or testing tools in professional software engineering
ISTQB or similar testing certification
Google Cloud certification

The role combines a focused application portfolio with complex operational dependencies. A new point-of-sale system has recently been introduced and offers further development potential, while the continued establishment of new stores places clear demands on scalable processes and dependable infrastructure. You work closely with colleagues across Digital, Technology, Facilities, Properties and the wider business to turn retail priorities into sustainable digital solutions. You lead a multidisciplinary organisation that includes digital leads, developers and managers.
About the role
As Head of Digital – Retail, you hold strategic responsibility for the digital direction, capabilities and contribution to business performance across the company’s retail network. You translate Lindex’s overall strategy into a clear digital direction, setting priorities and driving the development of digital solutions, data, AI and technology to support sustainable growth, profitability and long-term business success.
Working in close partnership with business and functional leaders, you ensure that digital priorities are aligned with business objectives and translated into tangible results. You lead digital development across the retail network, balancing reliable day-to-day operations with continuous improvement and future-focused innovation. By strengthening digital capabilities and embedding new technologies into retail operations, you enhance the employee and customer experience while driving efficiency and operational performance.
You also lead competence development in new digital capabilities and ways of working, strengthening Lindex digital maturity and ability to embrace future opportunities. Through collaboration across the organisation, you ensure that digital development supports both current business needs and long-term strategic ambitions.
The Head of Digital – Retail holds full accountability for the business team's digital direction, capabilities and contribution to commercial, financial, operational, sustainability and people performance. The role reports to the Chief Digital Officer (CDO).
Key responsibilities
Define the digital direction, priorities and roadmap for the retail area.
Ensure stable operations and continuous improvement of point-of-sale systems, RFID solutions, the employee retail app and security gate systems.
Identify opportunities to improve retail processes, including pricing, product handling and the establishment of new retails.

jobs.occupation: Software Product Developer to Mycronic Pattern Generator
jobs.description:
Mycronic is a global high-tech company whose innovative solutions have been advancing electronics technology for over 50 years. Today we continue to grow and serve customers in an expanding variety of industries. What we do impacts the future of technology, and in turn, the way we live our lives tomorrow. We’re looking for people to join our talented, motivated and friendly team on the cutting-edge. Here, in an open, collaborative and flexible environment, you’ll work alongside leading industry experts and take on challenging projects that bring tomorrow’s electronics to life.
About the role
We continue to grow within an expanding range of industries, and the Pattern Generator (PG) division holds a unique position in the market as the world's leading supplier of laser-based mask writers for photomask manufacturing, which, in turn, are used to produce high-resolution displays and semiconductors. For any high-resolution display produced in larger volumes that you see, whether it is a TV, phone, tablet, or smartwatch, Mycronic’s machines are a critical part of the manufacturing process. Our product portfolio also includes inspection machines that help ensure the quality of the photomasks used in display and semiconductors manufacturing.
In this role, you will be part of a larger team of 18 people responsible for the software and data processing that enable the machines to carry out their operations. The team works across a wide range of areas, from applications and data conversion to operating systems, computer hardware and internal networks. A key part of the work involves preparing and processing large volumes of data, with high demands on performance and reliability. This role will give you a broad understanding of how software and hardware interact within a complex system. You are not expected to know everything from day one. Curiosity, a willingness to learn and the ability to collaborate with colleagues with different areas of expertise are just as important.
Work tasks
In this role, you will have the opportunity to combine new product development with problem-solving and the continuous improvement of existing systems. Your primary focus will be software development in Java, where you will contribute to enhancing existing features, modernising systems, and addressing technical challenges within an advanced product environment. Your responsibilities will also include troubleshooting issues reported by customers, testing on physical test systems, and optimising code where performance is critical.
Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:
Developing and enhancing product software, primarily in Java.
Implementing new features and contributing to the modernisation of existing solutions while ensuring compatibility with previous product versions.
Writing tests and verifying functionality on physical test systems across various computer and system configurations.
Handling customer support cases through analysis and troubleshooting.
Developing software for user interaction and generating executable programs for the system.
Collaborating with colleagues across different technical disciplines to understand problems, identify solutions, and ensure that changes work seamlessly across the entire system.
Contributing ideas and suggestions for improvement as part of an ongoing product development process, driven by customer feedback and technological advancements.

We are looking for
To succeed in this role, you are curious and eager to understand how technology works as a whole. You take initiative, work independently and take ownership of your tasks, from initial analysis through to the delivery of a finished solution. At the same time, you are a team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and collaborating with others to achieve the best possible results. You are also adaptable, able to adjust when circumstances change, and thrive in a fast-paced development environment.
Furthermore, you have:
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related field.
At least a few years of experience in software development, working with products that combine both hardware and software.
Good knowledge of Java or experience with another object-oriented programming language, such as C++.
Experience in software development in a Linux environment.
Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

It is considered an advantage if you also have:
Experience in user interface development, preferably using frameworks such as React or similar.
Knowledge of agile development methodologies.

AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital provides highly qualified medical, emergency, and surgical veterinary care in a dynamic emergency setting and a welcoming environment.
AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital is part of Area North, which includes animal hospitals and clinics across fourteen locations. The hospital consists of the Emergency Department, Inpatient Care Ward, Surgery Department, Outpatient Clinic, Rehabilitation Department, as well as support functions including Telephone Services and Reception.

Outpatient consultations and medical workups.

Are you passionate about the intersection of Python programming, electronics, and radio frequency technology? On behalf of our client – an innovative and publicly listed telecom pioneer in Kista – Academic Work is looking for an RF Test Engineer. In this role, you will play a key part in the core R&D organization, developing automated test sequences for next-generation digital coverage solutions and 5G infrastructure. Apply today, as we apply ongoing selection!
About the role
Our client develops patented, digital coverage solutions (Distributed Antenna Systems) engineered for demanding environments such as rail and road tunnels, subways, arenas, and large commercial venues. Their systems support commercial cellular networks from 2G up to 5G, as well as mission-critical public safety networks. In this position, you will join a specialized hardware development team of around six engineers at the global headquarters in Kista. The role is focused on the intersection of software and electronics: your primary mission is to build, maintain, and optimize automated RF test sequences and scripts in Python to verify products at both module and system level before they transition into series production. Because the position requires hands-on verification with instruments and test rigs in the laboratory, work is primarily conducted on-site in Kista, with the possibility of working remotely one day per week.
You will act as an essential link between internal R&D and manufacturing. Internally, you will collaborate daily with hardware, mechanics, and radio engineers, as well as a larger software development team. You will have no direct customer-facing duties; instead, your primary external stakeholders are production partners and manufacturing facilities in Sweden and Estonia. The role includes occasional travel—approximately 3 to 4 weeks per year—to install, configure, and troubleshoot test setups on-site at the manufacturing plants. You will become part of an open, supportive engineering culture characterized by flat hierarchies, shared daily fika breaks, and a transparent mindset where catching mistakes early and solving complex challenges together is valued above all else.
You are offered:
A technically versatile role working with cutting-edge 5G and cellular hardware solutions.
A tight-knit, collaborative team culture with short decision paths and high engineering expertise.
Occupational pension aligned with ITP1, wellness allowance, and free access to the building’s gym facilities.

Work tasks
Develop automated RF test sequences using Python, perform hardware lab verifications, and coordinate with production sites to ensure product quality.

Department of Clinical Sciences
Do you have clinical experience as a small animal veterinarian, with expertise in reproduction and artificial insemination? An opportunity has arisen to join the Small Animal Department at the University Animal Hospital (UDS), working with reproduction and general veterinary care in a setting closely integrated with research and the teaching of veterinary-and veterinary nursing students. We look forward to receiving your application!
About the position
As a licensed veterinarian at University Animal Hospital, you will work at the Reproduction Clinic. The clinic provides diagnostic services and treatment for diseases of the reproductive organs, optimisation of mating timing, investigation and management of oestrus cycle disorders, fertility assessments, as well as semen collection and cryopreservation and artificial insemination.
You will also participate in general veterinary care as part of the varied day-to-day activities at Sweden's only university animal hospital, which operates around the clock.
The position includes evening, night and weekend shifts. Our operations run 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
You will receive support from our specialists and experienced colleagues in the team, helping you to feel at home in the clinic and develop professionally in your role.
As SLU is Sweden's only institution providing higher education for animal health professionals, you will play an active role in educating the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of the future, both in the clinical setting and through other teaching activities in animal reproduction.
You will also devote some of your time to reproductive research, with opportunities to apply for your own research funding or participate in other research projects. Our reproductive research is highly active and encompasses all animal species and all aspects of reproduction. The Department has access to advanced laboratory techniques, enabling both in vivo and in vitro studies, and benefits from well-established national and international collaborations.
Your profile
You are a licensed veterinarian authorised to practise veterinary medicine in Sweden. You have several years of clinical experience working at a small animal clinic. We would also like you to have experience as a reproduction veterinarian, with the skills required to perform routine procedures such as insemination, semen collection and cryopreservation.
As the position involves extensive contact with animal owners and students, you must have a good command of Swedish, both spoken and written, or have a good proficiency in English and be motivated to learn Swedish. The Department will support you in developing your Swedish language skills.
At the University Animal Hospital, we are customer-focused and committed to maintaining a professional approach characterised by goodwill and a positive attitude in our relationships with clients and colleagues. You are an effective communicator with the ability to establish and maintain good relationships with both clients and colleagues. You have an interest in teaching and in contributing to an environment that provides good conditions for research. As a veterinarian at the University Animal Hospital, you take a scientific approach to your work and have an interest in evidence-based veterinary medicine. You understand that working in an emergency service, where workloads are driven by unpredictable events and working hours are irregular, requires flexibility and adaptability.
As a person, you are well-organised, have good self-awareness and an understanding of what causes you stress, and are motivated to contribute to the organisation. In this recruitment process, great emphasis will be placed on your personal qualities and competencies.
About us
The Department of Clinical Sciences is responsible for undergraduate education, research and postgraduate education in the fields of anaesthesiology, diagnostic imaging, veterinary nursing, epidemiology, laboratory animal science, surgery, clinical chemistry, medicine and reproduction. Our activities in all these fields encompass all animal species.
At the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU), University Animal Hospital (UDS), education, research and advanced veterinary care go hand in hand. We educate the veterinarians and veterinary nurses of tomorrow and provide high-quality care for companion animals, competition animals and farm animals. We also share knowledge with the wider public. By combining established knowledge with the latest research findings, we are helping to shape the future of veterinary care.
Under one roof, we provide veterinary care for horses, dogs, cats and other small animals. In addition to modern facilities specifically designed for our operations, we have access to advanced diagnostic imaging equipment and a specialist veterinary diagnostic laboratory.

As a Data Architect, you will shape the future architecture of Alfa Laval's Global Data & Analytics Platform. You will work across business domains, source systems, data products and technical teams to create a connected, scalable and governed data landscape. Combining strategic architecture with hands-on data modelling, you will assess the current landscape, define the target architecture and help teams bridge the gap between the current and future states. 
 
Alfa Laval's global data landscape spans research and development, sales, service, operations, supply chain, finance, HR and sustainability, with data distributed across multiple source systems and structures. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, enterprise and solution architects, data product teams, developers and platform engineers to establish common standards, models and architectural principles. Your work will make enterprise data easier to find, understand, integrate and reuse, creating a scalable foundation for reporting, analytics, digital products and AI. 
 
Key responsibilities 
Define and drive a coherent data architecture for Alfa Laval's Global Data & Analytics Platform-creating one connected architectural direction across business domains, systems, products and value streams, including ERP, CRM and domain-specific solutions. 
Establish and promote common architectural principles, standards and guardrails for data modelling, governance, integration, interoperability, security, quality, scalability and reuse across the platform. 
Shape the target architecture and roadmap by assessing the current landscape, identifying gaps and dependencies, and defining practical steps towards a unified future state. 
Create and maintain consistent, reusable data models across business domains, supporting common definitions and enabling data to be used across multiple analytics and business use cases. 
Translate business requirements into enterprise-level data architecture, ensuring that data products and platform capabilities align with the overall architecture rather than creating isolated solutions. 
Work hands-on with architects, data engineers and developers to implement data models, integration patterns and shared platform capabilities. 
Partner with business and technical stakeholders to align priorities, explain architectural decisions, resolve trade-offs and build support across organizational boundaries. 
Collaborate with other architects and evaluate technologies to ensure the platform can support future analytics, AI and digital business needs. 

 
Who are you
You are a strategic and hands-on data architect who is comfortable working with ambiguity, navigating complex organizations and making decisions with incomplete information. You are pragmatic and structured, with a focus on implementable outcomes and long-term business value. Rather than creating isolated solutions, you are motivated by building reusable capabilities that can support the organization over time. You build strong working relationships with business and technical stakeholders and are comfortable working with people at different levels and in different disciplines. Strong experience in conceptual, logical and physical data modelling, including translating business requirements into data architecture and implementable data models.

Every day, we strive to develop, produce and sell products and services that are affordable and accessible to everyone. With us, you contribute to building a democratic brand and workplace that has a positive impact on both the planet and people's lives. 
 
Supply Chain Operations organization connects our customers with IKEA products in a simple, affordable, and sustainable way. We deliver excellent transport and logistic solutions today, tomorrow and over time by optimizing replenishment solutions, defining physical goods flow capacity needs, managing the goods flow, sourcing & developing transport & logistics capacities and leading & securing supply quality. 
Do you have a passion for developing business? Do you like handling different types of challenges and topics at the same time with various stakeholders both internal and external in a fast-pacing environment? Then this position might be something for you! 
Job Description

In Category Food Logistics Services, we source, procure, and operate cold chain transportation, warehousing and logistics services for IKEA Food. To support our growing business development agenda, we are currently looking for a Service Provider Operations Developer to join our Category Food Logistics Services Food team located in Älmhult! 
As a Service Provider Operations Developer, you will be responsible to secure and continuously improve our Service Provider's operational performance and maximize the optimization potential related to its operational costs - in close cooperation with business partners and relevant supply chain stakeholders. 
If you love the idea of joining a new business in Inter-IKEA, are not afraid to venture in the unknown and are motivated by co-creation and collaboration with a diverse range of stakeholders, then we would love to get to know you! 
As a Service Operations Developer, you will: 
Secure operational performance of the service provider as well as securing optimal usage of agreed capacity vs. planned/needed capacity 
Actively work with capacity forecasting, identify constraints and find optimal solutions which lead to securing needed capacity at lowest total cost. 
Support tenders & RFQs; contribute with local operational and market knowledge and details of service providers performance and operational capabilities  
Execute the operational tender request like out of tender purchase to secure the full coverage of transport needs for food daily operations. 
Contribute to development of working methods and other steering documents 
Monitor and secure execution of signed contracts and agreed terms & conditions. Perform compliance/spot checks at service providers to verify compliance with given parameters, such as quality of equipment, safety and security, etc. 

Qualifications

To be successful in this position we believe that you are: 
Experienced in working with Logistics or Supply Chain in an international organisation for at least 2 years 
Knowledgeable in specific aspects related to transportation and warehousing and main factors impacting operational performance 
Self-driven and analytical with a love for following up as well as comfortable with engaging and driving through our operational agenda with various stakeholders 
Proficient in working with Excel, including performing analysis and putting together reports 
M3 experience will be a plus experience 
Fluent in English, both verbal and in writing 

 
If you on top of this are inspired by IKEA’s values and our mission to provide a better everyday life for the many people as well as interested in working in one of the most dynamic areas in logistics, we would love to talk to you!  
Additional information

Get ready to assemble something new! We are currently looking for a new Quality Specialist to join our team and welcome your application. We look forward to receiving your application by the 17th of November, 2026. 
We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers employed in IKEA Supply Services (Sweden) AB and secondly impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group. 
At IKEA, we are looking for people who believe everyone deserves a seat at the table. You’re welcome no matter where you come from, what you believe, and what you look like. We don’t even care how you have furnished your home. We’re interested in you simply because you’re you. Even if your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that people’s different perspectives, backgrounds, and personalities make us better at understanding our customers’ dreams and needs. At IKEA we’re all on the same project. 
If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

jobs.description:
About the Tenure Facility
The Tenure Facility is the first and only international financial mechanism exclusively focused on securing land and forest rights for Indigenous Peoples and local communities worldwide. Recognizing and upholding these rights represents one of the most impactful opportunities for fostering sustainable rural development, achieving global climate goals, and mitigating local conflicts in a cost-effective manner.
Through grants and technical assistance, the Tenure Facility empowers Indigenous Peoples and local communities by strengthening their capacity to implement land and forest tenure reforms. Additionally, it supports governments in testing and scaling innovative approaches to land rights recognition, ensuring practical solutions to administrative and legal challenges.
Overview of the Position
The Grants Officer reports to the Chief Operating Officer and forms part of the Operations Team. The Grants Officer plays a key role in the implementation of the Tenure Facility’s grant-making and grant supervision processes. He or she will be responsible for administering the grant processes of the Tenure Facility’s projects and for ensuring that Tenure Facility staff members, consultants, and project partners operate within existing policies, guidelines, and procedures.
While the position falls under the Operations Team, given its strong programmatic focus, the Grants Officer is expected to work in close coordination with the Program Officers and the Finance Unit. The position may involve in-country visits to project partners.
Overarching Responsibilities
Contribute to establishing the Tenure Facility as a highly credible and respected foundation among international development institutions and donors.
Generate mutual trust and respect with Indigenous Peoples and local communities and their cultures, with full awareness of the intricacies of relationships among them and their allies and supporters.
Contribute to a collaborative and resilient internal working culture that supports sustained progress toward the Tenure Facility’s strategic goals and objectives.

Specific Responsibilities
The main responsibilities include:
Ensure that data related to grants and grantees in the Project Management System (Roots) is complete and meets Tenure Facility standards.
Work with Program Officers to provide prompt and sensitive responses to all unsolicited requests for funding and record related information.
Track the progress of project preparation, implementation, disbursement, reporting, and closure in Roots, and prepare related reports for management, donors, communications, and other stakeholders.
Coordinate the procurement of consultants and programme-related services, assist in preparing consultant contracts, ensure compliance with foundation regulations, and handle related queries, invoices, and payments.
Draft grant management documents, such as grant agreements, extensions, and amendments, for review by Program Officers and Financial Controllers, and manage related correspondence with grantees.
Review grant concept notes, proposals, risk registers, quality assurance reviews, and grant agreements to ensure they are complete and aligned with Tenure Facility policies.
Ensure the timely submission and approval of grantee reports by tracking and monitoring their status and sending reminders to grantees.
Shepherd grants and contracts through the review and approval process.
Assist with grant payment schedules, disbursements, and monitoring grant balances in coordination with Financial Controllers.
Assist with programme-related travel preparations and ensure reports are created and registered in TF systems.
Train new programme staff on grants and contracts processes and the use of the Project Management System (Roots).
Advise Tenure Facility staff members, consultants, and grantees on policies and procedures related to grant management.
Work to enhance and improve grants management processes and increase efficiency.
Undertake special projects as assigned.

Qualifications and Requirements
University degree (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent) in international development, law, business or public administration, social sciences, natural resource management, or a related field. A Master’s degree is an asset.
Minimum of 3 to 5 years of relevant professional experience in grants management, programme operations or administration, or project management, preferably with a foundation, international NGO, donor agency, or similar organisation.
Experience working with partners in Africa, and with Indigenous Peoples and local communities, is a strong asset.
Experience with grants management or similar information systems; familiarity with NGO Online (DigiPING) is an asset.
Fluency in English and French, both written and spoken, is required.
Fluency in Portuguese and/or Spanish would be considered an asset.
Willingness and ability to travel regularly, including to project sites and partner organisations in Africa, sometimes in remote locations.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and online collaboration tools.
Ability to work independently and as part of a multicultural, geographically distributed team, with cultural sensitivity and respect for Indigenous Peoples and local communities.

Terms of Employment
Permanent full-time position, starting 7 January 2027, with a six months' probationary period.
Location: Kungsholmen, Stockholm.
Collective agreement, pension and insurance: Almega Tjänstemannaavtalet.
Salary by agreement.

 
The Tenure Facility promotes a balanced, diverse workforce, a strength that helps us better understand and address our partners' needs, and we continually strive to improve our gender balance.

Nederman - The Clean Air Company  Founded by Philip Nederman in 1944, Nederman is now one of the world's leading companies supplying products and services in the environmental technology sector focusing on industrial air filtration. Our products and solutions are contributing to reducing the environmental effects of industrial processes, creating safe and clean working environments and boosting production efficiency, mainly within industries such as woodworking, metalworking, composite machining, food processing, vehicle service and emergency stations, laboratories and dentists. Nederman's offering encompasses everything from the design stage to installation, commissioning and service. Sales are carried out via sales offices and distributors in over 50 countries and development and production in own manufacturing and assembly units in 12 countries on five continents. Nederman Group, with headquarters in Helsingborg, Sweden is listed on Nasdaq OMX, Stockholm and has about 2500 employees.
Do you want to be the one who sets the direction for automation across an entire product portfolio? At Nederman, you get to work with technical innovation at a high level, in a dynamic team of skilled colleagues, all sharing the same goal - shaping the future of clean air. We do more than product development. We create solutions that truly make an impact, driven by knowledge and passion. 
The global Operational Technology Center (OTC) at Nederman is dedicated to advancing cross-product platform solutions that bridge the gap between traditional industrial equipment and modern digital technologies. Our focus lies in developing new ways of controlling our equipment to improve performance, reduce costs, and reduce their environmental footprint. Data is systematically collected through our fleet of connected devices, aiding our ongoing development initiatives, and delivering valuable insights. Empowered by cutting-edge AI technologies, we seamlessly provide these insights to our customers through user-friendly web and mobile applications. Robust, well-designed automation is the foundation all of this is built on. With a substantial and growing client base, we are committed to a rapid digital expansion.
The objective is to build highly integrated digital platforms to create products and solutions that only Nederman – The Clean Air Company can offer. We are now looking for a Senior Automation Lead to be the organization's primary automation expert and help shape what comes next.
About the roleAs Senior Automation Lead, you will be the technical leader and strategic driver for automation at Nederman's Operational Technology Center (OTC). You will shape the future of our control systems and automation platforms, ensuring robust, scalable, and maintainable solutions across our product portfolio. As the organization's foremost automation expert, you will provide technical direction, establish engineering standards, and guide key architectural decisions. A significant part of your role will be fostering technical excellence within the automation team through mentoring, coaching, and knowledge sharing. You will help build a strong automation capability that supports current product development and future innovation. While your primary focus will be automation and control systems, you will work closely with colleagues in software development, electronics, product management, and other engineering teams to ensure successful integration and alignment across solutions. This is a technical leadership role without formal personnel responsibility based on-site in Helsingborg.
Profile and experience
To be successful in this role you need
At least 8 years of experience in industrial automation, control systems, or Operational Technology, with several years in a senior technical role.
Deep expertise in industrial automation and control systems, including automation architecture, PLC-based control systems, industrial communication, HMI solutions, functional safety, and the development of robust, scalable automation platforms.
Being comfortable making architectural decisions and balancing immediate product needs with long-term technical strategy.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Swedish and English
Swedish citizenship. The position is security-classified and requires security vetting, including a background check.

Experience leading technical initiatives, influencing engineering direction and working with stakeholders and requirements is highly valued. Experience with Schneider EAE or IEC 61499 is an advantage but not required.
We are looking for someone passionate about automation and engineering excellence. You are curious, pragmatic, and energized by solving challenging technical problems while continuously improving products and ways of working. With a deep technical knowledge and strong collaboration skills, you bring structure, credibility, and a long-term perspective while remaining hands-on when needed. With a natural ability to lead through expertise and influence you truly enjoy developing people, sharing knowledge, and creating an environment where engineers can grow and perform at their best.
Apply today In this recruitment process Nederman collaborates with Mpya Sci & Tech. For questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Recruitment Consultant Christian Billberg on 0731-489 875. We review applications on a rolling basis so do not hesitate to apply via www.mpyascitech.com as soon as possible, as the position may be filled before the final application date.

 Your future team  
You will join the Data Science team composed of 45+ Data scientists and Machine Learning Engineers.  You will work in an international environment, collaborating with colleagues across disciplines to deliver end-to-end data and AI products used globally.

 In this role, you will turn complex business challenges into data products and AI solutions that create measurable impact, including sustainability outcomes. Working with global stakeholders, you will frame problems, define success metrics, and deliver solutions end to end.

 Strong opportunities to grow through global, cross-functional work and end-to-end product ownership

 Ready for the next move?

 Who we are and what we believe in
 We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
 Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. ​We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. ​We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
  
 Volvo Group Digital Technology & Operations (DTO) is a new division. The organizational set up is structured around domains, digital products with functions for digital excellence to deliver outstanding customer experience.

Looking for a workplace for the future?
At Telenor, you own your career. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make the most of your dreams and expertise while contributing to technological innovations that are barely even imagined today. Innovations that we know will change the way we communicate and live our connected lives in the future.
We are now looking for a Solution Architect to join our Strategy & Architecture team in Karlskrona.
How you'll make a difference with us
As a Solution Architect, you'll play a key role in shaping the technology solutions that support Telenor's future business and customer experiences. Working at the intersection of business and technology, you'll help transform complex challenges into secure, scalable, and sustainable solutions.
You'll be part of the Strategy & Architecture team and collaborate closely with business stakeholders, Enterprise Architects, development teams, and external partners. From early discovery and design through implementation, you'll help guide initiatives that modernize our digital landscape and create long-term value for both customers and the business.
In this role, you will:

Translate business needs into robust technology solutions

Shape solution architecture across complex business and technology domains

Drive modernization of our IT and digital landscape

Guide teams from concept and design through implementation

Balance customer value, business priorities, security, cost, and long-term sustainability

Ensure alignment with architecture principles and strategic direction

Your work will contribute to creating simpler, smarter, and more reliable digital experiences, helping our customers stay connected in a safe way.
Are you the one we're looking for?
We need someone who's always on their toes! You have a genuine desire to learn and develop so we can continue to meet our customers' ever-changing needs, today and tomorrow.
You're an architect who enjoys connecting strategy, business, and technology. You understand that the best solutions are not always the most complex ones, and you're comfortable influencing decisions across teams and stakeholder groups.
We believe you bring:

Experience designing end-to-end solutions in complex IT environments

The ability to communicate architecture and technical decisions in a clear and engaging way

Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills

A pragmatic mindset with the ability to balance big-picture thinking with attention to detail

A university degree or equivalent practical experience

Professional proficiency in English

It's a bonus if you also have experience with:

Telecommunications and digital services

BSS/OSS environments

Cloud platforms and cloud-native technologies

APIs, integrations, and microservices

AI technologies and emerging digital capabilities

Security architecture and secure-by-design principles

Most importantly, you're curious, adaptable, and motivated by solving problems, learning new things and helping shape the future of technology at Telenor.
Our promise to you!
We are better together. Here, you'll be part of a family-like and inclusive culture, built on strong shared values and leadership that empowers you with both trust and confidence. We believe in enabling each other to act and make decisions, while always having each other's backs through ups and downs.
We support relationships and societies. Telenor plays a vital role in society, giving your work a greater purpose. Every day, we create value for millions of people and maintain a customer-first approach where human relationships are at the heart of everything we do.
We make room for life. Work from home up to two days a week, if your role allows it. The rest of the time, we create magic together at the office. You also get two "give-me-a-break" days per year for extra time off, and our flexible working hours help you balance your time. We support you through every stage of life with our benefit package, including collective agreements, occupational pensions, wellness allowances, and customized insurance solutions tailored to your needs.
We invite you to a career in motion. Your development is at the center of our culture. We dedicate at least 40 hours per year to deepening your expertise, exploring new areas, and developing your role. Through Telenor Academy and other learning initiatives, you'll have the tools and freedom to advance your career. If you want to broaden your horizons, we are present throughout the Nordics.
Apply today!
Will you take the next step in your career with us? We look forward to your application! We review applicants on an ongoing basis, so don’t wait—reach out today.
If you have any questions or want to know more, feel free to contact the hiring manager Liam Forde at liam.forde@telenor.se. Please note that we cannot accept applications via email.
